msg: Hi, I booked the 2 dive trip for this Friday on your website last week, for me and my girlfriend. Now we need to move it to Sunday, and my brother wants to join us. How do we do that?
reply:
Date changes and adding people to an existing booking are subject to availability and our terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/

This needs to be checked by a person from our team, who can see bookings, payments and emails. I'm passing you to a Diving Planet advisor now and they'll get in touch with you shortly. Thanks! 🙌

msg: Thanks. While I wait: my brother isn't certified, can he do the mini course on the same boat as us on Sunday? How much is it?
reply:
Yes! The Dive Mini Course is for people without prior certification, and he can join the same boat if you’re departing from Cartagena. If you’re already on the Rosario Islands, pickup depends on whether your hotel has boat access. The price depends on your departure point, so I’m leaving both options below.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD (655.000 COP · 727.000 COP)
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Dive Mini Course: 134 USD · 149 USD (475.000 COP · 528.000 COP)

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll send you the exact plan and booking link. 🌊
